verses.he: לְֽ֭תַאֲוָה יְבַקֵּ֣שׁ נִפְרָ֑ד בְּכָל־תּ֝וּשִׁיָּ֗ה יִתְגַּלָּֽע׃
verses.en: He that separateth himself seeketh his own desire, And snarlest against all sound wisdom.

verses.he: לֹֽא־יַחְפֹּ֣ץ כְּ֭סִיל בִּתְבוּנָ֑ה כִּ֝֗י אִֽם־בְּהִתְגַּלּ֥וֹת לִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: A fool hath no delight in understanding, But only that his heart may lay itself bare.

verses.he: בְּֽבוֹא־רָ֭שָׁע בָּ֣א גַם־בּ֑וּז וְֽעִם־קָל֥וֹן חֶרְפָּֽה׃
verses.en: When the wicked cometh, there cometh also contempt, And with ignominy reproach.

verses.he: מַ֣יִם עֲ֭מֻקִּים דִּבְרֵ֣י פִי־אִ֑ישׁ נַ֥חַל נֹ֝בֵ֗עַ מְק֣וֹר חָכְמָֽה׃
verses.en: The words of a man’s mouth are as deep waters; A flowing brook, a fountain of wisdom.

verses.he: שְׂאֵ֣ת פְּנֵי־רָשָׁ֣ע לֹא־ט֑וֹב לְהַטּ֥וֹת צַ֝דִּ֗יק בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.en: It is not good to respect the person of the wicked, So as to turn aside the righteous in judgment.

verses.he: שִׂפְתֵ֣י כְ֭סִיל יָבֹ֣אֽוּ בְרִ֑יב וּ֝פִ֗יו לְֽמַהֲלֻמ֥וֹת יִקְרָֽא׃
verses.en: A fool’s lips enter into contention, And his mouth calleth for strokes.

verses.he: פִּֽי־כְ֭סִיל מְחִתָּה־ל֑וֹ וּ֝שְׂפָתָ֗יו מוֹקֵ֥שׁ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: A fool’s mouth is his ruin, And his lips are the snare of his soul.

verses.he: דִּבְרֵ֣י נִ֭רְגָּן כְּמִֽתְלַהֲמִ֑ים וְ֝הֵ֗ם יָרְד֥וּ חַדְרֵי־בָֽטֶן׃
verses.en: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, And they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

verses.he: גַּ֭ם מִתְרַפֶּ֣ה בִמְלַאכְתּ֑וֹ אָ֥ח ה֝֗וּא לְבַ֣עַל מַשְׁחִֽית׃
verses.en: Even one that is slack in his work Is brother to him that is a destroyer. .

verses.he: מִגְדַּל־עֹ֭ז שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה בּֽוֹ־יָר֖וּץ צַדִּ֣יק וְנִשְׂגָּֽב׃
verses.en: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: The righteous runneth into it, and is set up on high.

verses.he: ה֣וֹן עָ֭שִׁיר קִרְיַ֣ת עֻזּ֑וֹ וּכְחוֹמָ֥ה נִ֝שְׂגָּבָ֗ה בְּמַשְׂכִּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, And as a high wall in his own conceit.

verses.he: לִפְנֵי־שֶׁ֭בֶר יִגְבַּ֣הּ לֵב־אִ֑ישׁ וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָב֣וֹד עֲנָוָֽה׃
verses.en: Before destruction the heart of a man is haughty, And before honour goeth humility.

verses.he: מֵשִׁ֣יב דָּ֭בָר בְּטֶ֣רֶם יִשְׁמָ֑ע אִוֶּ֥לֶת הִיא־ל֝֗וֹ וּכְלִמָּֽה׃
verses.en: He that giveth answer before he heareth, It is folly and confusion unto him.

verses.he: רֽוּחַ־אִ֭ישׁ יְכַלְכֵּ֣ל מַחֲלֵ֑הוּ וְר֥וּחַ נְ֝כֵאָ֗ה מִ֣י יִשָּׂאֶֽנָּה׃
verses.en: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; But a broken spirit who can bear?

verses.he: לֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן יִקְנֶה־דָּ֑עַת וְאֹ֥זֶן חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים תְּבַקֶּשׁ־דָּֽעַת׃
verses.en: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; And the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.

verses.he: מַתָּ֣ן אָ֭דָם יַרְחִ֣יב ל֑וֹ וְלִפְנֵ֖י גְדֹלִ֣ים יַנְחֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: A man’s gift maketh room for him, And bringeth him before great men.

verses.he: צַדִּ֣יק הָרִאשׁ֣וֹן בְּרִיב֑וֹ יבא [וּבָֽא]־רֵ֝עֵ֗הוּ וַחֲקָרֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He that pleadeth his cause first seemeth just; But his neighbour cometh and searcheth him out.

verses.he: מִ֭דְיָנִים יַשְׁבִּ֣ית הַגּוֹרָ֑ל וּבֵ֖ין עֲצוּמִ֣ים יַפְרִֽיד׃
verses.en: The lot causeth strife to cease, And parteth asunder the contentious.

verses.he: אָ֗ח נִפְשָׁ֥ע מִקִּרְיַת־עֹ֑ז ומדונים [וּ֝מִדְיָנִ֗ים] כִּבְרִ֥יחַ אַרְמֽוֹן׃
verses.en: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city; And their contentions are like the bars of a castle.

verses.he: מִפְּרִ֣י פִי־אִ֭ישׁ תִּשְׂבַּ֣ע בִּטְנ֑וֹ תְּבוּאַ֖ת שְׂפָתָ֣יו יִשְׂבָּֽע׃
verses.en: A man’s belly shall be filled with the fruit of his mouth; With the increase of his lips shall he be satisfied.

verses.he: מָ֣וֶת וְ֭חַיִּים בְּיַד־לָשׁ֑וֹן וְ֝אֹהֲבֶ֗יהָ יֹאכַ֥ל פִּרְיָֽהּ׃
verses.en: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; And they that indulge it shall eat the fruit thereof.

verses.he: מָצָ֣א אִ֭שָּׁה מָ֣צָא ט֑וֹב וַיָּ֥פֶק רָ֝צ֗וֹן מֵיְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a great good, And obtaineth favour of the LORD.

verses.he: תַּחֲנוּנִ֥ים יְדַבֶּר־רָ֑שׁ וְ֝עָשִׁ֗יר יַעֲנֶ֥ה עַזּֽוֹת׃
verses.en: The poor useth entreaties; But the rich answereth impudently.

verses.he: אִ֣ישׁ רֵ֭עִים לְהִתְרֹעֵ֑עַ וְיֵ֥שׁ אֹ֝הֵ֗ב דָּבֵ֥ק מֵאָֽח׃
verses.en: There are friends that one hath to his own hurt; But there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
